During an academic visit hosted by Prof. Dr. Serge Shapiro, Dr. Denis Anikiev delivered two invited seminars at Freie Universität Berlin.

The Geo-Colloquium talk, *Emerging Trends in Generative AI for Seismic Imaging*, examined applications of generative models in exploration, earthquake-hazard research, and geothermal studies. A second seminar for the Applied and Earthquake Seismology group, *Machine Learning and Generative AI for Microseismicity*, focused on data-driven methods for passive-seismic analysis.

The visit also provided an opportunity to discuss ongoing cooperation and new directions in AI-driven geophysical imaging.
